name: challachat
description: TypeScript version of the ChallaChat standalone app: local YouTube chat scraper + overlay server

scripts.pack:win: npm run build && pkg --compress Brotli --targets node22-win-x64 --out-path build dist/http/server.js
scripts.pack:mac:x64: npm run build && pkg --compress Brotli --targets node22-macos-x64 --out-path build dist/http/server.js
scripts.pack:mac:arm64: npm run build && pkg --compress Brotli --targets node22-macos-arm64 --out-path build dist/http/server.js
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && pkg --compress Brotli --targets node22-linux-x64 --out-path build dist/http/server.js
scripts.pack:all: npm run pack:win && npm run pack:mac:x64 && npm run pack:mac:arm64 && npm run pack:linux
